transcripts.pcp.submitted_valid: This is {practice}. Face-to-face mobility evaluation is on file. Home assessment confirms the wheelchair fits. {pcp_name} has signed the standard written order for {patient_name} dated today for a {equipment}, HCPCS {hcpcs}. The signed order will be sent today.
transcripts.supplier.not_accepting: We are not accepting new Medicare patients at this time. Please try another supplier.
transcripts.supplier.no_k0001: We mainly stock power chairs and scooters. We do not provide {equipment} or {hcpcs} devices.
transcripts.supplier.out_of_stock: We do accept Medicare Part B and new patients, but our {equipment} units are temporarily out of stock. Call back in a few days.
transcripts.supplier.qualified: Yes, we are taking new Medicare Part B patients. We accept assignment so the patient only pays the 20% coinsurance. We have {equipment} {hcpcs} in stock and can deliver to {patient_city} in two days.
transcripts.supplier.confirmed: Delivery completed today for the {hcpcs} equipment to {patient_name}.
